🎬 CASTING DO SPOTU REKLAMOWEGO
Role bez tekstu.

Zgłoszenia tylko drogą mailową

Poszukujemy aktorów/epizodystów:

Mężczyzna — 24 lata

Młody, atrakcyjny mężczyzna o wyrazistej twarzy i ciemnych włosach. Szczupła, proporcjonalna sylwetka.

Typ: miejski, nowoczesny, premium / corporate.

Zadbany, pewny siebie, ambitny, ale jednocześnie ciepły i rodzinny.

Ważna naturalność i swoboda przed kamerą.

Kobieta — 19 lat

Młoda kobieta o charakterystycznej, naturalnej urodzie i wyrazistej twarzy. Długie ciemne włosy, szczupła sylwetka.

Typ: niezależna, współczesna, z charakterem.

Mile widziana naturalna, nieoczywista uroda i mocna ekranowa osobowość.

Mężczyzna — 70–80 lat

Senior o bardzo charakterystycznej twarzy, siwych włosach i zaroście. Szczupła lub średnia sylwetka.

Szukamy osoby ciepłej, wiarygodnej i emocjonalnej, potrafiącej opowiadać historię przede wszystkim spojrzeniem i mimiką.

Naturalność i autentyczność mile widziane.

Mężczyzna — 30–40 lat

Przystojny, charakterystyczny mężczyzna o wyrazistych rysach i ciemnych włosach.

Postać pojawia się w kilku okresach życia: 1968 / 1972 / 1975 / 1980, dlatego ważna jest możliwość wiarygodnego pokazania upływu czasu.

Typ: charyzmatyczny, męski, ekranowy.

Kobieta — 30–40 lat

Kobieta o ciepłej, klasycznej urodzie i charakterystycznej twarzy.

Kobieca, elegancka, rodzinna, naturalna.

Postać również pokazujemy w różnych okresach – lata 60., 70. i 80.

Ważna umiejętność wiarygodnego przechodzenia między różnymi etapami życia i stylami epoki.

Kobieta — 40–50 lat

Ciepła, zadbana, atrakcyjna kobieta o naturalnym wyglądzie.

Typ: współczesna mama – silna, troskliwa, rodzinna.

Naturalna mimika i wiarygodność przed kamerą ważniejsze niż „modelowy” wygląd.

Mężczyzna — 45–55 lat

Zadbany, męski, naturalny mężczyzna. Krótkie ciemne włosy, możliwy lekki zarost.

Typ: spokojny, pracowity, rodzinny tata.

Szukamy naturalności, ciepła i wiarygodności, bez przesadnie „reklamowego” wizerunku.

📍 Zdjęcia w Warszawie w 2 połowie października 

📩 Zgłoszenia:

blackwolfproductionpl@gmail.com

📝 W treści zgłoszenia podaj:

• Imię i nazwisko

• Wiek

• Numer telefonu

• Zdjęcie twarzy i całej sylwetki

• Wizytówka lub/i demo (link do YouTube)

Pozostałe szczegóły przekażemy wybranym osobom.

Szukam osób/aktorów w wieku 35+ do nagrywania prostych wideo własnym smartfonem w stylu UGC.

🔴 CZYTAJ DO KOŃCA ZANIM NAPISZESZ

Szukam osób w wieku 35+ do stałej współpracy.  Nagrania to zwykłe wideo mówione (telefonem, bez montażu, bez wrzucania na swoje profile, duża elastyczność i dowolność wyboru scenerii). Wideo będzie wykorzystywane do kampanii reklamowych w social mediach, promujących usługi naszej firmy.

Co jest do zrobienia:

Nagranie krótkich wypowiedzi wg prostego scenariusza (surowy materiał).

Pierwsze zlecenie: pakiet 10 nagrań (15-45 sekund każde) = 500 zł za komplet. 

Przy sprawnej realizacji - stała, regularna współpraca.

Wymagania:

Telefon z dobrą kamerą i czystym dźwiękiem, światło dzienne, naturalność przed kamerą, swoboda wypowiedzi.

Chcesz spróbować?

Wyślij mi na prywatną wiadomość krótki (nawet 15-20 sek.) filmik próbkowy nagrany telefonem - powiedz do kamery jak masz na imię, ile masz lat i np. co dzisiaj robiłeś/aś. Bez obróbki i filtrów. Wybrane osoby dostaną skrypt do pierwszego pakietu.

**CASTING CALL – N.E.S.T. PROJECT**

@everyone

We’re looking for people to join us on **24th and 25th September** as we continue filming the N.E.S.T. Project in **Mossley, Tameside**.

Whether you’ve acted before or this is your first time in front of a camera, we’d love to hear from you. **No previous experience is required.**

N.E.S.T. is a voluntary independent film project, so this is an unpaid opportunity. Those involved will also have the opportunity to receive IMDb credits for their contribution to the project.

If you’re interested in getting involved, please email **casting@emberproduction.com** with a little information about yourself and your interest in joining the cast. Our team will be happy to provide further details.

We’re incredibly grateful to everyone who has supported the project so far, and we look forward to welcoming more people into the N.E.S.T. family.

**Dates:** 24th & 25th September

**Location:** Mossley, Tameside

**Experience:** None required

#NESTProject #EmberProductions #CastingCall #IndependentFilm #Mossley

sharedPost.text:
🎬 CASTING CALL | WE NEED SOME MEAT 🥩

Right then... who's got the chops?

Sunny Runny Productions are on the hunt for PETE “THE MEAT” JENNINGS, a major supporting role in our debut feature film, No Gentle Goodnight, shooting in Runcorn from the end of October 2026.

Firstly, a massive thank you to Dave Oz for stepping in as Pete for our original proof-of-concept trailer. As we move into the full feature, we're now recasting the role.

PETE “THE MEAT” JENNINGS
Male | Playing age 50s -60s | Northern

Pete is a local butcher and an old face from David's past.

He's a hulking slab of sweat, sarcasm and questionable dietary choices, usually found in a butcher's apron with a pork pie in one hand and an opinion nobody asked for in the other.

Funny without trying to be. Rough around the edges. The sort of bloke you probably already know... and if you don't, you've definitely avoided eye contact with him in a pub.

But don't mistake Pete for comic relief.

There's a proper character underneath that apron and some cracking material for the right actor to get their teeth into.

We need presence. Someone who can make us laugh without playing for the laugh, handle the heavier dramatic stuff when it comes, and make Pete feel like a real bloke rather than a collection of Northern stereotypes.

THE FILM

No Gentle Goodnight is a British independent psychological crime thriller, written by Terence Caddick and directed by Mark Holland. Produced by Sunny Runny Productions & Going Nowhere Productions.

We're a low-budget independent production, and we're not pretending otherwise.

Our cast and crew are working on a contracted profit-share basis, because we'd rather be completely upfront about what we're doing from day one.

But low budget doesn't mean two blokes with an iPhone and a packet of crisps.

We're putting together a proper feature-film production with an experienced cast and crew, professional cinema equipment, structured shoot days and a team of people determined to make something we're all proud to put our names on.

We might be independent. We might be doing it differently.

But we're doing it properly.

🎥 Feature film
📍 Runcorn, Cheshire
📅 Principal photography begins end of October 2026
🎬 Approx. 4 filming days for Pete, subject to final schedule
📆 Filming predominantly Sundays
🎭 In-person auditions in Runcorn
💷 Contracted profit-share role
🍴 Catering provided on filming days
🎞️ Full screen credit

Experience is welcome, but we're much more interested in finding Pete than collecting the longest CV.

If you've got natural screen presence, good comic timing and can bring the dramatic chops when they're needed, we want to hear from you.

Send us your name, playing age, location, recent photo/headshot, acting experience/CV and a showreel if you have one. No showreel? Don't let that stop you. Tell us a little about yourself anyway.

Selected applicants will be invited to audition in Runcorn.

We've got the script.
We've got the cast.
We've got the crew.
We've got the locations.
We've got the kit.

We're just a bit short on MEAT. 🥩😂

EMAIL - casting@sunnyrunnyproductions.com

NO GENTLE GOODNIGHT | 2027 🎬

Looking for a First Nations Woman 65+ to be an actress in our short film.

Jigsaw Casting Ltd. Is Seeking Cigarette Smokers ages 30+ across Canada who have cut back or are trying to quit for a ZONNIC Testimonial Campaign!

We are looking for the following people:
1. Individuals who are actively quitting or cutting back with ZONNIC. You are currently using the product and able to speak to it first-hand.

2. Individuals who are looking to quit or cut back — and you are open to trying ZONNIC. You are motivated to change the habit, not yet a ZONNIC user. You are open to trying the product ahead of the shoot.

3. Individuals who have tried other NRTs without success — open to switching. Those who have attempted to quit with other nicotine replacement therapies that did not work.

4. Individuals who have recently quit by using ZONNIC.

If selected – This is a compensated, non-union project, with total potential compensation of up to $5,100.00 per person, depending on final usage and survival of the edit. Buyout includes all lifts, edits and versions for a 1 year period.

Requirements
• Aged 30+ and visually read as 30+ on camera.
• Resides in Canada. Everyday Canadians from diverse backgrounds
• Currently smokes and is either cutting back or looking to quit, able to describe it unprompted.
• Comfortable speaking honestly and being publicly attributed.

DEADLINE TO SUBMIT - ASAP OR BEFORE OCTOBER 7, 2026 AT 9AM EST.
You must be available for these dates if selected:

Recall: October 16 via in person (Montreal) or zoom (other cities).

Shoot: 1 day in between Nov 19 to 30. Location TBD: Either in Montreal, Toronto or Vancouver. Travel and accommodation will be provided if you don't live close to the studio in one of those cities. Travel dates will be 1 or 2 days before the shoot.

If interested, you must apply and submit a self tape to:
https://zonniccampaign.castingcrane.com/

Self tape instructions:
1. Introduce yourself.
2. What makes you want to quit or cut back?
3. What personal goals is ZONNIC helping you unlock?

UCCS DIGITAL FILMMAKING CAPSTONE FILM AUDITIONS

The UCCS Digital Filmmaking program has a new Fall semester section of our capstone course, and the three students in the class are gearing up for their capstone film auditions being held October 10 from 10:30am - 7pm on the UCCS campus.

I try to structure the auditions and the film shoots for our capstone course in a way that is as actor-friendly as possible:
* Auditions are held on UCCS campus on the weekends when there is free parking
* I have students hold auditions in groups of 3, so you can potentially audition for up to 3 films in one visit (you will be asked in the Calendly signup to note all of the films and roles you would like to audition for)
* Each film is only allowed one 12-hour shoot day between October 25 - November 15, so you can potentially act in multiple films with a minimal time commitment
* All filming locations will be in or very near to Colorado Springs

COPY OF FINAL FILM AND FOOTAGE

Students are required to use their OneDrive accounts to share a copy of the finished film AND all film footage with actors by the end of the semester (I enforce this by withholding the grade on their film if they don’t provide proof that they’ve shared everything with their actors). This is a great way to get footage for your reel.

HOW TO SIGN UP FOR AUDITIONS

The following link will take you to a OneDrive folder with the casting calls for all three films, and all casting calls will have the Calendly link to sign up for an audition time:

[[https://shorturl.at/gSyoH](https://shorturl.at/gSyoH)](https://shorturl.at/gSyoH?fbclid=IwcGRvZgFleHRuA2FlbQIxMABicmlkETFsQ2R1NW0wdFp6bUdkOTlMc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHjuY9YZxtm8qLjm4QFUuopxeD9V_BguEOV_Mjp8muExGFiEG1U500cTvOXkY_aem_NtBgZU-ZD-UGMDvZkCxRHg)

* The production date and audition date is listed on each casting call, as are character breakdowns. Please make sure you are available on the production date and fit the requirements of the role you are auditioning for before signing up for a time. If you have questions about individual films (including whether or not they will accept virtual auditions), please reach out to the contact email on the casting call. If you are having trouble accessing the casting calls, please DM me and I’ll get back to you ASAP.

You can view UCCS capstone films from the past few years at this link:

[https://shorturl.at/mc1K1](https://shorturl.at/mc1K1)

Thank you everyone for supporting our student filmmakers!

*ljude alternativnijeg i "cool" izgleda

* svi izvan traženog profila su također dobrodošli 

𝗖𝗔𝗦𝗧𝗜𝗡𝗚 će se održati 𝘂 𝗛𝗢𝗧𝗘𝗟𝗨 𝗪𝗘𝗦𝗧𝗜𝗡 𝗨 𝗭𝗔𝗚𝗥𝗘𝗕𝗨 (𝗞𝗿𝘀̌𝗻𝗷𝗮𝘃𝗼𝗴𝗮 𝟭), u dvorani "ZRINJEVAC" 𝘂 𝗣𝗢𝗡𝗘𝗗𝗝𝗘𝗟𝗝𝗔𝗞 (𝟮𝟴.𝟵.), 𝗨𝗧𝗢𝗥𝗔𝗞 (𝟮𝟵.𝟵.) 𝗶 𝗦𝗥𝗜𝗝𝗘𝗗𝗨 (𝟯𝟬.𝟵.), 𝗼𝗱 𝟭𝟬:𝟬𝟬 𝗱𝗼 𝟭𝟴:𝟬𝟬 𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶. 

Pozivamo vas da dođete u što većem broju i da iskusite filmski set iz prve ruke, a da pritom steknete zanimljivo novo iskustvo i poznanstva. 😊 

Ako ste se prepoznali u objavi, ili poznajete nekoga za koga smatrate da odgovara opisu, proslijedite im oglas ili ih povedite sa sobom na casting. 😊
 
Veselimo se vašem odazivu i vidimo se! 

*𝗡𝗔𝗣𝗢𝗠𝗘𝗡𝗔: Ako NISTE u mogućnosti doći na casting, svoju prijavu za sudjelovanje možete poslati i na e-mail adresu: 

mp.produkcija.casting@gmail.com

I’m looking for two young actresses for a new series project, The Ausländer Diaries. And extras

• Playing age: 14–17
• Both must speak Russian, English
• Filming in Berlin

The series is set in 2002, based on a true story, and follows two girls between Berlin and post-Soviet Russia.

Previous acting experience is welcome, but young/emerging talent is encouraged to apply.

CASTING CALL - N.E.S.T. PROJECT @everyone
We’re looking for people to join us on 24th and 25th September as we continue filming the N.E.S.T. Project in Mossley, Tameside.
Whether you’ve acted before or this is your first time in front of a camera, we’d love to hear from you. No previous experience is required.
N.E.S.T. is a voluntary independent film project, so this is an unpaid opportunity. Those involved will also have the opportunity to receive IMDb credits for their contribution to the project.
If you’re interested in getting involved, please
email casting@emberproduction.com with a little information about yourself and your interest in joining the cast. Our team will be happy to provide further details.
We’re incredibly grateful to everyone who has supported the project so far, and we look forward to welcoming more people into the N.E.S.T. family.
Dates: 24th & 25th September
Location: Mossley, Tameside
Experience: None required
#NESTProject #EmberProductions #CastingCall #IndependentFilm #Mossley

✨Are you Looking for a Show-Stopping Performance for Your Holiday Event? ✨

Make your celebration unforgettable with an energetic and talented dancer. we’ve been bringing excitement and energy to events of all kinds—from Corporate events, birthdays, anniversaries, Tv guesting and more!

Our performance categories include:

• Modern Dance
• Cultural Dance
• Hawaiian Dance
• Belly Dance
• Folk Dance 
• Kids party 
• Contemporary Dance
• Back-up Dancer
• Drum Beater
• Dance Instructor
• Festival Dancers
• Led Dance 
• Fire Dance 
and many more…..

For bookings and inquiries, contact me Ruby Uy📞 09912109256 or Pm our page Alta Dance Company. 

Let us light up your celebration with our exceptional talent and enjoyment! 🎉

For more details, visit our page and get in touch today!

items.text:
*GABRIEL AMPONSAH MENSAH*
Leader - Street Vibes Acrodancers
Accra, Ghana
Phone: 0557573491 / 0552361887
Email: amposahgabriel3@gmail.com]

*PROFESSIONAL PROFILE*
Highly skilled and dedicated Acrobatic Team Leader with 6 years of experience leading the renowned Street Vibes Acrodancers. Expert in high-energy street acrobatics, team leadership, and international performance. Proven track record performing at major national events and internationally in Kuwait and Saudi Arabia. Committed to excellence, discipline, and thrilling audiences.

*LEADERSHIP EXPERIENCE*
*Team Leader & Lead Performer*
_Street Vibes Acrodancers | 2020 - Present (6 Years)_
- Lead, train and manage a team of professional acrodancers for daily performances
- Create and choreograph powerful acrobatic routines including flips, tumbling, human pyramids, contortion and balance acts
- Ensure safety and discipline during all rehearsals and performances
- Handle bookings, negotiations and client communication for events

*PERFORMANCE HIGHLIGHTS*
- *University of Ghana, Legon - Opening Ceremony Performance*
- *National Theatre of Ghana - Live Stage Performance*
- *International Tour: Kuwait - Acrobatic Showcase*
- *International Tour: Saudi Arabia - Cultural Performance*
- Numerous street shows and private events across Accra

*CORE SKILLS*
- Acrobatic Mastery: Front & Back Flips, Aerial Tumbling, Hand-to-Hand Balance
- Human Pyramid Formation & Contortion
- Choreography & Creative Direction
- Team Leadership & Youth Mentorship
- Stage Presence & Crowd Engagement
- Physical Strength, Flexibility & Stamina

*STRENGTHS*
Hardworking, Disciplined, Fearless Performer, Good Team Spirit, Punctual

*REFERENCES*
Available on request.

🎬 PAID CASTING CALL — LOS ANGELES / PALMDALE AREA

THE COLONY — Sci-Fi / Horror Short Film
Proof of Concept for a Feature Film

📍 Location: Palmdale / High Desert, CA
📅 Shoot: Late September / Early October
⏱ Approx. 6–8 hours
🎥 Festival submissions + online release
🍴 Meals provided + transportation/gas stipend

CASTING:

MAYA — Female Lead | 25–35 | $200

* Level-headed, observant, resilient
* Athletic / physically capable
* Recently out of a difficult relationship
* Starts reserved but becomes the group’s survivor
* Significant physical/action performance
* Lead role

TRISH — Female Supporting | 25–35 | $125

* Sara’s close friend
* Social, confident, adventurous
* Strong chemistry with Sara
* Must be comfortable in a bikini for a hot-tub scene
* Horror/action sequences

RYAN — Male Supporting | 25–35 | $125

* Video game developer
* Trish’s boyfriend
* Funny, laid-back, slightly immature
* Comedic relief before the horror escalates
* Must be comfortable shirtless for a hot-tub scene

ABOUT THE FILM:
The Colony is a sci-fi horror creature short inspired by classic creature features. A group of friends head to a desert getaway, only to discover something deadly lurking beneath the property.

The short is being produced as a proof of concept for a feature-length film, combining live-action filmmaking with professional creature VFX.

TO SUBMIT:
Please DM with:
• Headshot / recent photo
• Acting reel or clips (if available)
• Role you’re interested in
• Availability late September / early October
• Los Angeles-area location

Paid, non-union independent production.

items.text:
**PAID CASTING CALL - TV PILOT (Multiple characters)**

**Project:** "Deadly Chess Royale", a gothic steampunk Live Action Anime Thriller (yes, Live Action Anime like Netflix's One Piece Live Action Anime)
**Location: **New York City
**Showrunner, Producer, Director: **Tiger Lapis
**Production Dates:** Between Nov 1, 2026 to Jan 1, 2027 (exact dates TBD)
**Union Status: **Open to Union and Non-Union actors, but this will be a SAG Union shoot (We will Taft-Hartley Non-Union actors)
**Compensation: **TBD based on Role (SAG Union Rate)

**About the Series:**
Two women geniuses battle in chess to choose who dies as one seeks revenge and the other fights to follow her heart in a futuristic gothic New York City.  One is Detective Julia Jeng, the genius detective and Master Strategist leading the white chess team.  The other is her former childhood friend, Officer Julia Cho, the Master Manipulator leading the black chess team. 
The series is like "Alice in Borderland" meets "The Queen's Gambit" and "Death Note". 

**Casting for the Following Characters:**

**1) Detective Julia Jeng, Lead**
Age: Looks like in their late 20s

Ethnicity: East Asian (will consider mixed-race East Asian)

Height: at least 5'4" or TALLER 
Fit 

Willing to do action/fight scenes (you will have a LOT) 

Character is like a beautiful Tomboy 

Prefer someone with some martial arts / kickboxing or fight experience 

*Highly Preferred if you also have a deep, low voice 
*Actress needs to have a strong physical presence, and action-hero confidence with emotional vulnerability.

*If you are Non-Union, we will Taft-Hartley you 

Genius Detective Julia Jeng (leader of the White Chess Team) fights to stay true to who she wants to be in a world that tries to force her to be someone she's not.  A Master Strategist and a tough, strong woman who is intense, like an untouchable blade, she's also quirky, blunt, direct, sarcastic, and a bit of an oblivious idiot when it comes to romance.  Although her social skills are a bit lacking and she doesn't open up easily (nor does she like to be vulnerable), she's quite lonely, and has suffered major trauma when her family was destroyed.  Still, she tries her best to never give up.  A very passionate person who gives it her all, she is the one who fights with love in her heart.   Most importantly, this is a woman who must inspire the audience. This is someone who can do the impossible and believes she can do the impossible.  She doesn't conform to society, she doesn't fit in, but no one else is like her.  She'll go through an incredibly difficult journey in the show through deadly chess games she must play against her former childhood best friend to choose who dies, and is forced with morally-complicated choices as the world tries to force her to be someone she doesn't want to be. 
There is romantic tension between Detective Julia Jeng and lead male, Detective Kazuki Kamijo.
FYI this is NOT NCIS or that type of show.  This is a Gothic Steampunk Noir Thriller ala Tim Burton inspired style, similar to the tone, vibe, and world of Tim Burton's "Batman Returns".   And is very much a Live Action Anime, similar to how One Piece is a live action Anime.

*Schedule: Most likely will need around 14-16 days of filming for your role + rehearsals for fight choreography **(see below how to Submit)**

**2) Detective Kazuki Kamijo, Lead**
Age: Looks like in their Late 20s or early 30s

Ethnicity: East Asian OR mixed-race East Asian

Height: at least 5'9" -  6'4" or taller 
Fit 

Willing to do action/fight scenes (you will have a LOT) 

Prefer someone with some martial arts / kickboxing or fight experience 

*If you are Non-Union, we will Taft-Hartley you 

Detective Kazuki Kamijo (on the White Chess Team) is the lead male character and the right-hand man of Detective Julia Jeng in the Deadly Chess Games she must play against her former childhood best friend, The Master Manipulator Officer Cho.  Kazuki is a strong, grounded character who is wise, sincere, deeply compassionate, has a great balance of strength with a soft side to him, a bit of dry humor, is incredibly smart, and the one who grounds the lead protagonist Detective Julia Jeng, his best friend whom he has worked together with before.  Whereas Officer Cho tries to seduce Julia Jeng into the darkness of revenge, Kazuki tries to keep Julia Jeng in the light. There is strong Romantic tension between him and Julia Jeng as well.  Actor must be able to deliver words of wisdom. This is a deep character. Kazuki is loyal to the New York Police Department and the top shooter on the force. He is also one of the best fighters on the White Chess Team, with incredible combat skills and abilities. There are also layers to Detective Kazuki Kamijo as this is a complex character.  There is more to this guy. 

*Schedule: Most likely will need around 8-10 days of filming for your role **(see below how to Submit)**

**3) Helen Nakamura, the ASSASSIN (series regular)**
Age: Looks like in their early 20s or Younger 
Ethnicity: East Asian (prefer Japanese)
Willing to do action/fight scenes (you will have a LOT) 

Prefer someone with some martial arts / kickboxing or fight experience 
*If you are Non-Union, we will Taft-Hartley you

Helen Nakamura, the ASSASSIN (on the Black Chess Team). She is psychotic and the most volatile and mentally unstable character in the entire series. Also deemed the best and most dangerous fighter on the black chess team. Although she is in her 20s, she dresses like a young Japanese schoolgirl due to a traumatic event that left her frozen mentally in that time period. She uses her youthful looks to her advantage on her unsuspecting targets. She is the right-hand woman of the Master Manipulator, former police officer Cho, who leads the black chess team. A bit of Cho's pet, she is intensely loyal to Cho and no one else, which is why Cho is the only one who can control her.

*Schedule: Most likely will need around 3-6 days of filming for your role + rehearsals for fight choreography **(see below how to Submit)**

**4) John Cho, the ARSONIST, Series Regular**
Age: Looks like in their 20s to early 30s 

Ethnicity: East Asian (prefer Korean)

Willing to do action/fight scenes 
Added bonus if you have some martial arts / kickboxing or fight experience 

*If you are Non-Union, we will Taft-Hartley you 

John Cho, the ARSONIST (on the White Chess Team). He is the Korean bad boy of the series. Pretty much a total a**hole, and nearly all his teammates dislike him as he can't get along with anyone. Obsessed with fire, he is highly skilled when it comes to using fire as a weapon, understanding the inner mechanics of how it flows and works. He has a highly self-destructive personality and is an avid smoker, where most of the time you will see him with a cigarette in his mouth. (Note: Actor will NOT smoke real cigarettes) He is highly artistic though, known for his illegal graffiti art. No one wants to work with him. He says everything offensive to everyone around him. He does, however, has a bit of a chill uncaring personality, and doesn't talk much unless to offend someone. Most of the time, he looks like he doesn't give a f*** about anything. A bit of a nihilist, he hides his feelings behind a traumatic past.

*Schedule: Most likely will need around 3-6 days of filming for your role **(see below how to Submit)**

**5) Raven Chan, the THIEF (series regular)**

Must have MARTIAL ARTS EXPERIENCE! 

*This role requires a lot of martial arts choreography and fight scenes. We are looking for someone who is a highly trained martial artist! If you have ROPE DART experience, it's an added plus! 

Raven Chan, the THIEF (on the Black Chess Team), is a notorious professional thief who is hired to steal artifacts, antiques, and paintings worth millions of dollars. He also has a string of successful bank robberies under his belt. His motto is, “Anything you ask, I’ll steal.” Oddly chauvinistic, a trickster, and even polite (when he’s not fighting). He is jokingly known as the “Hong Kong pop star” given his beautiful looks, and is recognized for his premature snow white hair that has been caused by a traumatic childhood event. Raven is an avid violin player, often carrying a violin case on his back. What others don’t realize is that in his violin case hides a dangerous martial arts weapon. He is in a romantic relationship with Em.

*Schedule: Most likely will need around 4-7 days of filming for your role + rehearsals for fight choreography **(see below how to Submit)**

**>>> **✨**How to Submit (for above characters):**
Please email deadlychessroyale@gmail.com (NO Dm's):
**Subject Line: **"Casting Submission: [Character Name ] - [Your Name]"
* Headshot
* Resume
* Acting reel 
* Action/Fight Reel (if you have one, not required, but it helps!)
* Note if you have any martial arts background/experience, kickboxing, etc. (not required)
* Current Location 
* Social Media links (if you're on Social)
* Availability for November 1-January 1, 2026 (Expect around 8-16 days of filming + rehearsals, depending on your role)

**Submission Deadline:** September 29, 2026

Note: This is an Ensemble Cast of 14 main characters!  I only posted some key characters here, but there are 11 more series regular characters listed on Casting Network (different ethnicity, not all are Asian characters).   That should be posted soon -- I'm waiting for Casting Network to approve the post.  Keep an eye out for that and check there also!  It's called "Deadly Chess Royale - TV Pilot".

CASTING - publicité de parfum (projet étudiant)

On tourne à Angers le 3 et/ou 4 octobre 2026, en journée, pour une publicité de parfum fictive réalisée dans le cadre d'un exercice pédagogique et donné par Studio M Angers.

Tous les rôles filmés sont muets (aucune réplique à jouer), alors n'hésitez pas à candidater même sans expérience.

Les profils recherchés :

- L'égérie du parfum : un homme, 25 à 45 ans, profil charismatique. Corpulence athlétique et cheveux mi-longs à longs appréciés (assez pour simuler le vent dans les cheveux), mais tous les profils seront étudiés.

- La religieuse : une femme, 30 à 80 ans (voir plus), tous profils. Un rôle à jouer sur un ton sévère humoristique et décalé.

- La maman : une femme, 30 à 80 ans, tous profils.

- L'homme du parc : un homme, 25 à 80 ans, tous profils.

On cherche aussi une voix off homme pour la toute dernière phrase de la pub : une voix posée, grave, bien placée. Pas besoin d'être devant la caméra pour ce rôle, un extrait audio suffit à candidater. Vous pouvez candidater à plusieurs rôles.

Les rôles sont très ouverts côté physique, à l'exception peut-être de l'égérie du parfum : ne vous autocensurez pas, quel que soit votre profil.

Projet non payé/défrayé. Collations et boissons prévues sur place, repas fourni si le tournage déborde sur l'heure du déjeuner ou du dîner.

Aucune vocation commerciale : le parfum, la marque et la campagne sont entièrement fictifs, c'est un exercice de formation pour les étudiants en BTS Audiovisuel de Studio M Angers.

Pour candidater : envoyez-nous quelques photos récentes, votre âge, votre ville, et si vous en avez une, une bande-démo ou une vidéo de présentation (pour la voix off, un extrait audio est bienvenu).
Contact : goldenlight.rh@gmail.com ou DM.

**URGENT CASTING: JIGSAW CASTING IS LOOKING FOR CANADIAN BASED AMERICAN GIRLS AGES 13-16. MUST STILL HAVE AMERICAN ACCENT SOCCER / FOOTBALL PLAYERS WITH GOOD ABILITY**

This is casting in Canada but filming in Brazil. All travel and accommodation are included for talent and one parent.

We are continuing the Dove campaign to keep our girls in sport – and for this project in particular, soccer! For more information: https://bit.ly/doveconfidentsports

Girls are too often being told their bodies are wrong for sports. Too tall. Too short. Too strong. Too soft. We’re not losing girls because they can’t play. We’re losing them because the world tells them their bodies don’t fit the game.

Our film invites us to talk about their first touch, their passes, their shots. We will be filming real football on the pitch, on the street - wherever our girls are playing.

We are looking for 13 - 16 year-old girls ( with American accents) who actively have a high or medium level of football from various positions: goalkeeper; striker; centre, defence.

We are looking for a broader range of body shapes, sizes, abilities, ages, football levels to make sure it’s more universal and inclusive. We want real footballers, with their real bodies.

For this video we are NOT looking for girls that are currently signed with model / acting agencies or that have already taken part in any professional modelling or advertising.

Filming will be in Brazil - which is the venue for next year’s Women’s World Cup – there will be girls from different countries taking part and all travel / hotels for selected girls plus one parent will be arranged and paid for. Such a great opportunity !!

**Must be available for these key dates:**

Callbacks: October 14 or 15, 2026. Via zoom.

Filming / Photography

In November we estimate approx. 5 days to include travel, prep and filming:

Travel: Between November 23 to 25 to Brazil. Return home on November 28, 2026.

Shoot: November 26 and 27, 2026.

Payments come in two parts:

Day rates are paid to the girls confirmed for this project for the actual days booked and generally about 4 - 5 weeks after filming.

DAY RATES: - rates given in Euros as per contract per person.

Travel / Prep etc - 130 euros

Filming - 257.50 euros

Parents (Chaperone ) 100 dollars per day ( not incl callback)

Usages - global all media - 12 months

Hero - speaking talent - 5,500 euros

Supporting/ non featured - 2,750 euros

**Deadline: ASAP or before September 28, 2026 at 10am EST.**

Usage is not guaranteed as it is subject to your appearance in the final live materials, final media plan and paid once these are live – Spring 2027. The planned rates are - global all media - 12 months. We will have a better idea which category your child is in after the callbacks.

If interested, please apply with a self tape to:

https://dovesoccer.castingcrane.com/

Self tape instructions:

https://bit.ly/dovesoccerselftape

Hello Actors! I'm Jon Wilkinson. I'm currently creating several series out here in the Denver area. This upcoming Saturday time TBD we're filming the first recurring series. It will be the first Reality Court Drama (Judge Judy/People's Court) filmed here in Colorado called Equal Justice. We have an amazing actor Marty Lindsey as our Judge. 

UGC NON-UNION

When: Saturday September 26th

Time: TBD

Location: Watkins, Colorado (20 minutes east of Aurora)

Paid: $50 per role with a $100 back end compensation upon monetization

Snacks and Beverages available on set

***STRONG IMPROV BACKGROUND PLEASE***

Roles: 

Plaintiff- Actress 18+ 

Defendant- Actress 18+

Plaintiff- Actor 18+ 

No scripts, IMPROV'd roles. Need grounded believability. 

Cases should take anywhere from 45 minutes to an hour to shoot. You'll be arguing your case that we go over this week in front of the Judge. No gallery audience, just the Judge, Plaintiff and Defendant. High energy. You can be as eccentric or mysterious as you'd like. 

-----------------------------------------------------------------

We have several shows upcoming. In Arvada and Jessica McKeehan's AMAZING studio space in Watkins where we're shooting Equal Justice. Here's a SNEAK PEEK look at the set for The Bridge! in Arvada. Another recurring series. Actors that work with me now will be added to a list and guaranteed an audition for the upcoming shows! Thank you!

Equal Justice: equaljusticecasting@proton.me

CASTING CALL: 📢📢📢
SELF-TAPES

*LAST DAY TO UPLOAD SELF-TAPES IS SEPTEMBER 24th*

Title: The Art of Making Mistakes

Genre: Drama, Comedy, Student film. 

Logline: The Art of Making Mistakes is a dark comedy that centers on an over productive father, who’s worked hard to provide for his family, and his son, who’s faced the consequences of his absence.

CHARACTERS:

Larry (Early 30s, Hispanic): A machismo father who has spent his whole life building a home for his wife and son, only to realize he’s never actually had time to live in it. Brash. Stuck in his ways.

Xavier (8–12, Hispanic): A young boy forced to write his school report on his macho, enigmatic father. Curious and stubborn. Questions others as much as he questions himself. Where he goes, trouble follows.

Tom (Any race, 40s-50s): A machismo boss at a construction company. Distances himself from co-workers to avoid attachment. Utterly professional. A straight shooter.

Maria (Early 30s, Hispanic): An old-school Hispanic mother. Fiercely protective. The only thread keeping her family intact. Understands that forgiveness and discipline are a balancing act.

Shooting will take place within late October and early November. Filming for 4 to 5 days on the Westminster, CO and Denver, CO area. 

We will provide a meal every day; there will also be snacks and drinks. Once post-production is complete, those involved in the project will be given access to the short.

Email david.renteria@ucdenver.edu for more information.

Questionnaire Link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScZbnd6G43o9kvIBCAONBET8JQXmajxk9Ioz_UuqglvcFle6A/viewform

 

Sides Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lqpfE0JoAiuSXBdspj6xwrPvHV3vdvRH?sort=13&direction=a

sharedPost.text:
Polska to jednak dziwny kraj, w którym przestępcom zza wschodniej granicy – nazywanym przez naszych rządzących sojusznikami, przyjaciółmi czy bliskimi sprzymierzeńcami – żyje się bardzo dobrze. Dzięki naszym politykom mogą oni czuć się bezkarnie! W biały dzień, w bestialski sposób przypominający mordy na naszych przodkach z lat 40. ubiegłego stulecia, żywota pozbawia się dwóch księży i sprawcy rzekomo nic nie grozi. Zupełnie nic, ponieważ biegli sądowi i lekarze mogą stwierdzić u niego chorobę psychiczną wywołaną pobytem w okopach na froncie. Gdy wojna się skończy, a żołnierze m.in. Pułku Azow przyjadą do Polski – bo przyjadą, gdyż w Ukrainie pozostaną rzekomo zgliszcza i ruiny – będą doskonale wiedzieć, że są bezkarni. Świadomi, że zawsze można zasłonić się stanem psychicznym, będą mogli krzywdzić zwykłych polskich obywateli z przeświadczeniem, że prawo stoi po ich stronie 🇵🇱 

#polska

#cezaryandrzejkrajewski

🎙️ VOICE-OVER CASTING — CINEMATIC MEDIEVAL DRAMA
We’re looking for a professional male or female narrator for an immersive short-form medieval drama.

📖 Project: Narrative Voice-Over

📝 Script: Approximately 5,880 words / 18 pages

💰 Compensation: $2,500 USD

⏱️ Turnaround: 72–75 hours

🎧 Delivery: High-quality MP3, delivered chapter by chapter

🎬 Style: Cinematic, atmospheric, emotionally engaging, story-driven narration

🗣️ Accent: Clear, neutral English preferred

The ideal voice actor should be comfortable with expressive storytelling, natural pacing, emotional transitions, and bringing a dramatic narrative to life.

Post-production: Our team will handle final editing, mixing, and sound design. Talent is only responsible for delivering clean, professional voice recordings.

No AI cloning, AI training, or synthetic voice use is involved.

Interested? Please contact Andrew Logan at:

📧 marcusturam61@gmail.com

Please include a brief introduction, your voice-over experience, and a demo/reel if available.

We look forward to hearing from talented narrators interested in bringing this story to life! 🎙️

ADVANCED MEISNER ACTOR TRAINING - HERE IT IS AT LAST! 

Ready to take your Meisner work to the next level?

Our Second Year Advanced Meisner Actor Training begins Thursday 5th November 2026 at the Meisner Institute London.

Go beyond the foundations with intensive scene work, character, text and performance training. By completing the programme, you will develop three key skills:

* Sustained truthful listening and responsive behaviour under complex circumstances.
* Deeper character and text analysis, helping you make specific, playable choices.
* Greater freedom and emotional range in performance, with the confidence to remain instinctive in demanding scenes.

The programme culminates in showcase work, with opportunities to progress into further performance and film projects.

THURSDAYS | 2PM–5PM
📍 The Cockpit Theatre, Central London
📅 Starting 5th November 2026
🎭 Small class – maximum 12 actors

ENTRY REQUIREMENT
Actors must have completed our Meisner Core Actor Training / First Year Training, or an equivalent full Meisner training programme elsewhere.

Not sure if your previous training qualifies? Get in touch and tell us about your experience.

Places are very limited so don’t delay!

📩 hello@meisnerlondon.com

MEISNER INSTITUTE LONDON
Truthful. Instinctive. Alive.

🎬 **CASTING CALL — NYC INDEPENDENT SHORT FILM**

Casting 9 roles for ***HOME***, an indie short film about a young woman preparing to leave New York and questioning what it truly means to feel at home.

📍 **Location:** New York City — local hires only

📅 **Filming:** Select days between **October 4–11**. Exact dates will be determined partly around cast availability.

💵 **Compensation:** Unpaid. Meals, copy, and credit provided.

**AVA — Lead**
Female, mid-20s, Black. Warm, sociable, effortlessly stylish. Bilingual French/English required.

**GABE — Supporting**
Male, mid-20s, White, American. Native New Yorker with laid-back skater/surfer energy. Playful and affectionate, with an undefined romantic connection to Ava.

**DANIEL — Supporting**
Male, mid-20s, with a foreign accent. Nerdy, relaxed, funny, and deeply dependable.

**MAGGIE — Supporting**
Female, mid-20s, American. Funny, impulsive, unapologetically chaotic, and sharper than people assume.

**AHMED — Featured**
Male, late 30s. Middle Eastern, South Asian, Eastern European, or Latin American. Warm, familiar, and easygoing neighborhood deli worker.

**AVA’S MOTHER — Voiceover**
Female, 45–65. Loving, practical, and caring without being overbearing. Fluent French required.

**NEIGHBOR — Featured**
Male, mid-20s, American. Character is gay. Attractive, charming, and naturally easygoing.

**SPARK’S OWNER — Day Player**
Female, mid-20s to early 30s, White or Asian American. Polished and friendly, with a SoHo “clean girl” style. Ideally owns a suitable dog to play SPARK.

**SPARK — Dog, Day Player**
Friendly and outgoing. Must be comfortable with actors, city noise, and repeated takes.

To submit, email your **headshot, résumé, reel or relevant footage**, and any conflicts between October 4–11 to:

📧 **homeshortfilm646@gmail.com**

**Email subject: NAME OF ROLE**

Casting für junge Künstler:

Dinnershow im Krönum

**Du bist ein talentierter Künstler und möchtest deine Fähigkeiten in einer einzigartigen Dinnershow präsentieren? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!**

 

Wir suchen junge, kreative Künstler aus den Bereichen Akrobatik, Tanz, Musik, Comedy und mehr, die Lust haben, bei einer exklusiven Dinnershow im Krönum mitzumachen. Du kannst dich auch gerne als Duo bewerben!

 

So kannst du dich bewerben:

 

-   Schick uns ein kurzes Video (max. 3 Minuten) von deinem Auftritt oder einer Performance, die du vor kurzem durchgeführt hast. Zeige uns deine Fähigkeiten und deine Leidenschaft für die Bühne!

-   Wir treffen eine Vorauswahl und laden die ausgewählten Künstler zu einem persönlichen Casting ein, das am 01.10. stattfinden wird. In absoluten Ausnahmefällen ist auch ein anderer Termin auf Anfrage möglich.

 

Warum teilnehmen?

-   Du erhältst die Chance, Teil einer einzigartigen Dinnershow im Krönum zu werden.

-   ﻿Die Shows beginnen im März und enden im Dezember. Gespielt wird an den Wochenenden und in den sächsischen Ferien. Details folgen.

-   ﻿﻿Es warten spannende Auftrittsmöglichkeiten und ein kreatives Team auf dich.

-   Du kannst dich vor einem begeisterten Publikum präsentieren.

 

Bewerbung:

Sende dein Video inkl. Bilder, sowie eine kurze Beschreibung deiner Person bis spätestens 30.09.2026 an [kulti@turisede.de](mailto:kulti@turisede.de).

Infos zum bereits laufenden Krönum: [https://www.turisede.com/kroenum.html](https://www.turisede.com/kroenum.html)

 

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und vielleicht bald gemeinsam auf der Bühne im Krönum zu stehen!

🚨🔥 NOCH EINMAL AUFGEMACHT! 🔥🚨

FREUNDE 😍😍😍!!
Ihr habt uns nach einem weiteren Termin gefragt und deshalb legen wir am 01. & 02. November 2026 noch einmal nach 👮‍♂️🎬!

Wir öffnen dafür nur noch wenige Plätze für unseren POLIZEI-AUFBAU-WORKSHOP.

Und das ist definitiv kein klassischer Schauspielworkshop. 😉

Hier geht’s um das, was man auf der Kamera sehen muss: authentisches Verhalten, sichere Abläufe und glaubwürdiges Agieren in realitätsnahen Einsatzsituationen.

🎬 Realistische Einsatzszenarien
👮 Personenkontrollen, Durchsuchungen & Fesselungstechniken
🚔 Personentransport & Verbringen ins Einsatzfahrzeug
🥋 Selbstverteidigung & Umgang mit aggressiven Personen
🔫 Professionelles Waffenhandling
🎯 Betreutes Schießtraining auf einer Schießanlage
💥 Training unter Stress & situatives/taktisches Agieren

Tag 2 steht komplett im Zeichen des Schießtrainings – professionell angeleitet und in kleinen Trainingsgruppen.

📍 01.11.2026 – Dachau
📍 02.11.2026 – Schießanlage Oberschleißheim

⚠️ WICHTIG: Das ist ein AUFBAU-Workshop.

Er richtet sich an Teilnehmer, die bereits unseren Basis-Workshop absolviert haben oder entsprechende berufliche bzw. langjährige praktische Erfahrung mitbringen.

Zum Beispiel aus:
👮 Polizei
🪖 Bundeswehr
⚖️ Justiz
🛡️ Sicherheitsdienst
🎬 oder durch umfangreiche Erfahrung mit Polizeirollen vor der Kamera

Wir schauen uns jede Anmeldung individuell an und klären vorab, ob dein Erfahrungsstand für den Aufbau-Workshop passt.

Denn genau das macht den Unterschied:
Wir wollen nicht einfach möglichst viele Teilnehmer – wir wollen, dass die richtigen Leute miteinander trainieren können 🔥.

📩 Infos, Preis & Anmeldung:
Schreibt uns an info@komparse.tv

Wenn du also schon Erfahrung mitbringst und Polizeirollen vor der Kamera auf das nächste Level bringen willst:
👉 Meld dich jetzt.

Die Plätze sind bewusst begrenzt – und wenn sie voll sind, sind sie voll 👮‍♂️🔥🎬😜!

Wir sehen uns in Dachau & Oberschleißheim! ❤️‍🔥

Szukam osób/aktorów w wieku 35+ do nagrywania prostych wideo własnym smartfonem w stylu UGC.

🔴 CZYTAJ DO KOŃCA ZANIM NAPISZESZ

Szukam osób w wieku 35+ do stałej współpracy.  Nagrania to zwykłe wideo mówione (telefonem, bez montażu, bez wrzucania na swoje profile, duża elastyczność i dowolność wyboru scenerii). Wideo będzie wykorzystywane do kampanii reklamowych w social mediach, promujących usługi naszej firmy.

Co jest do zrobienia:

Nagranie krótkich wypowiedzi wg prostego scenariusza (surowy materiał).

Pierwsze zlecenie: pakiet 10 nagrań (15-45 sekund każde) = 500 zł za komplet. 

Przy sprawnej realizacji - stała, regularna współpraca.

Wymagania:

Telefon z dobrą kamerą i czystym dźwiękiem, światło dzienne, naturalność przed kamerą, swoboda wypowiedzi.

Chcesz spróbować?

Wyślij mi na prywatną wiadomość krótki (nawet 15-20 sek.) filmik próbkowy nagrany telefonem - powiedz do kamery jak masz na imię, ile masz lat i np. co dzisiaj robiłeś/aś. Bez obróbki i filtrów. Wybrane osoby dostaną skrypt do pierwszego pakietu.

**Zaprzyjaźnij się ze swoim ciałem i uwolnij emocje na warsztatach tanecznych!**

U nas profesjonalizm spotyka się z dbałością o dobrostan i poczuciem bezpieczeństwa uczestników.

Odwiedź stronę FB Centrum Twórcze Przestrzenie lub Czuła Fundacja. Możesz też odwiedzić naszą stronę internetową: https://www.czulafundacja.pl/ 

Dowiedz się więcej o czułej i twórczej przestrzeni, którą dla Ciebie budujemy.

Poznaj prowadzącego grupę SQARE Kacper Mucha. Kacper jest profesjonalnym tancerzem i choreografem. Ale nie zapomniał o tym, co dawał mu taniec w dzieciństwie. Był sposobem na rozładowanie energii i emocji z całego dnia.

"Pracuję z uczestnikami nad większym poczuciem własnej wartości i lepszym osadzeniem w swoim ciele. Wzmacniamy je i rozwijamy koordynację ruchową. Dzięki temu zaprzyjaźniamy się ze swoim ciałem i emocjami. Obserwujeny siebie i swoje reakcje. Poznajemy sami siebie. Chcę, żeby „Square” było dla Was bezpiecznym miejscem, w którym uczycie się zaufania do siebie i świata, zglębiając profesjonalne techniki taneczne".

Jeżeli chcesz poszukać tańca w sobie i siebie w tańcu, dać sobie przestrzeń na rozwój i po prostu się poruszać — przyjdź do nas!

Grupa SQUARE startuje już w najbliższy poniedziałek 21 września o 18.00 na ul. Marymonckiej 34!

Poniższe zdjęcie jest z uroczystej Gali Zakończenia Sezonu Artystycznego, którą co roku organizujemy w naszej Fundacji. Na Gali prezentują się wszyscy chętni uczestnicy naszych zajęć. Wspieramy się wzajemnie i tworzymy pełne zaufania więzi. Dołącz do naszej społeczności!

Bądź z nami w najbliższy poniedziałek! Zapraszamy młodzież I dorosłych.

Jeśli chcesz dowiedzieć się więcej - napisz do nas na adres: czulafundacja@czulafundacja.pl

items.text: My name is Jennifer Roberson & I’m a talent agent with The Wayne Agency and we were started in Los Angeles in 2009. Our agency is expanding their roster & is hosting an open call for actors looking for representation in the Atlanta, South Central/Texas, Los Angeles, Virginia/East and New York markets. Ages 5 and up. There is no fee with this reputable open call and no fees attached and there will be no costs if signed. We are a proud SAG-AFTRA franchised agency governed by SAG-AFTRA rules. For the audition, please prepare a 30-60 second commercial (that you connect with and can show us your “brand”) and also either a scene or a monologue. If you select a scene, you may perform a scene from tv/film and please keep it between 2-3 pages. **OR** for a monologue, please perform a piece that is no longer than 1-2 minutes. If we are interested, we will reach out to you to schedule an in-person audition time, October30-Nov.1st in the Denver area. Please submit the Google form below. If you do NOT have a GMAIL account, please send everything listed on the Google form to the email address: twashowcase@gmail.com. If you have a question, please ask it below.  See the Google link in the comments below. Here is our website

items.previewDescription: The Wayne Agency is a SAG-AFTRA and WGA franchised talent and literary agency representing actors, musicians, models, voice-over artists, social influencers, and literary clients.

Hi Jennifer Roberson ! I actually just did a huge media upgrade with a retired casting director of CBS - Jen Rudolph and the wayne agency is on her list of recommended agents! I will definitely send an email over soon to you!

🎉 CASTING PAID ROLES, NON-SPEAKING + PETS - CLOSED 🎉

Veteos, a local veterinary video production company, is looking for the following roles and pets in a training video about working with challenging clients for a veterinary pharmaceutical company's Veterinary Training Series. 

**We will be filming next Tuesday, September 29th from 5-8pm in Parker, CO**. A W9 and signed release are required. Each scene requires about 2 hours of filming. Non-Union. Usage is corporate training material, no ads or social media placement. 

All roles are non-speaking, but must be able to successfully emote anxiety, anger, sadness, fear, etc. that comes with having a pet at the vet. To submit, please facebook message me your headshot, a photo of your pet if applicable, and confirmed availability for the 29th The roles are below:

Veterinarian - ($250) problem solver, genuine

Customer Service Rep - ($250) able to calm upset client

Dog and Owner (medium/large dog) - ($250) must be able to act multiple emotions genuinely

Cat and Owner - ($250) must be able to act multiple emotions genuinely

I can't wait to see your submission!

What’s included:

-1-hour headshot session

-Full access to all your RAW files

-Professional hair & makeup add-on available

Availability is limited between now and October 9th, so if you’ve been needing fresh headshots or want to add some new looks before I leave California, feel free to message me and we’ll set up a time!

🌐 www.kooheadshots.com

📸 Instagram: @kooheadshots

Looking forward to working with some of you before the big move! 😊🗽

***PAID ~ LEAD ACTOR & SUPPORTING ACTOR***

Still searching for a **lead actor** and a **supporting actor ****theatre-trained preferred but not required** for my proof-of-concept short film, ***TATE-MONROE***. We are currently in pre-production, with the shoot date TBD in December in LA. We're also securing funds through donors, grants, contests, and a Seed&Spark crowdfunding campaign, so it will be a paid gig! 

If this sounds like an opportunity for you or someone you know, please have them email me at **willloperjr@gmail.com** with their portfolio. A little about the project below:

**TATE-MONROE: *****Caleb Pierce returns to Steele University’s campus after surviving the school shooting that took his brother’s life, only to discover the story being told is far from the unsettling truth.***

**Caleb Pierce (Inspo: Jharrel Jerome, Kelvin Harrison Jr.)**
* (late 10s/early 20s, Black) with a deep, Southern voice that echoes
* Business-casual athlete (5'11"-6'4, basketball)
* Dealing with PTSD and survivor's remorse

**Dr. Riley Miller (Inspo: Michael Shannon, Bryan Cranston)**
* (50s/60s, White), older, lanky, and balding with a Southern gentleman drawl
* Clean-cut, Brooks Brothers formal, business-minded
* A string of men trying to protect Steele's legacy

Additonal materials available upon request!  🙏🏽

items.text:
**Crew Call - Los Angeles** NO/LOW PAY

I'm looking for crew for a short film that will be used for a promotional and crowdfunding campaign. The writer/director and cinematographer are AFI alumni with established producers onboard. It will be a weekend 2 day shoot, currently targeting to film either October 10-11 or 17-18. Locations are yet to be confirmed but likely around LA and potentially Boyle Heights.

About the film:
The film follows a TikTok star suffering from an anxiety attack while stranded inside his trailer during a film shoot, but an unexpected encounter with a production assistant forces him out of his isolation and into a brief connection with the world around him. Our film explores the complexities of anxiety, isolation, and the self-imposed pressures we face in our pursuit of success.

As this is no-budget, we're only able to offer small stipends or kit fees. Although our goal is to find the crew we want to continue working with for the feature as well.

We're currently looking for:
Costume/Prop Master combo ($200 flat stipend/kit fee)
Sound Mixer w/gear ($300 flat stipend/kit fee)
Script Supervisor ($200 flat stipend/kit fee)
Intimacy Coordinator (1 day only, probably 8 hrs, $100 flat)

We are covered generally for other positions, but please feel free to send your resume in case of last minute availability changes.

If interested in collaborating, please email  sarahniver@gmail.com with your desired position in the subject line along with your resume or CV and portfolio (if applicable). Thank you so much!

items.text:
Casting für junge Künstler:

Dinnershow im Krönum

**Du bist ein talentierter Künstler und möchtest deine Fähigkeiten in einer einzigartigen Dinnershow präsentieren? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!**

 

Wir suchen junge, kreative Künstler aus den Bereichen Akrobatik, Tanz, Musik, Comedy und mehr, die Lust haben, bei einer exklusiven Dinnershow im Krönum mitzumachen. Du kannst dich auch gerne als Duo bewerben!

 

So kannst du dich bewerben:

 

-   Schick uns ein kurzes Video (max. 3 Minuten) von deinem Auftritt oder einer Performance, die du vor kurzem durchgeführt hast. Zeige uns deine Fähigkeiten und deine Leidenschaft für die Bühne!

-   Wir treffen eine Vorauswahl und laden die ausgewählten Künstler zu einem persönlichen Casting ein, das am 01.10. stattfinden wird. In absoluten Ausnahmefällen ist auch ein anderer Termin auf Anfrage möglich.

 

Warum teilnehmen?

-   Du erhältst die Chance, Teil einer einzigartigen Dinnershow im Krönum zu werden.

-   ﻿Die Shows beginnen im März und enden im Dezember. Gespielt wird an den Wochenenden und in den sächsischen Ferien. Details folgen.

-   ﻿﻿Es warten spannende Auftrittsmöglichkeiten und ein kreatives Team auf dich.

-   Du kannst dich vor einem begeisterten Publikum präsentieren.

 

Bewerbung:

Sende dein Video inkl. Bilder, sowie eine kurze Beschreibung deiner Person bis spätestens 30.09.2026 an [kulti@turisede.de](mailto:kulti@turisede.de).

Infos zum bereits laufenden Krönum: [https://www.turisede.com/kroenum.html](https://www.turisede.com/kroenum.html)

 

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und vielleicht bald gemeinsam auf der Bühne im Krönum zu stehen!

🎬 **BEZAHLTER COMEDY-WERBEDREH: **

**Frau ca. 45–65 Jahre für diesen Freitag in Wien gesucht**

Für ein kurzes Social-Media-Werbevideo mit einem bekannten österreichischen Creator suchen wir kurzfristig eine sympathische, humorvolle Frau, die gerne vor der Kamera steht.

**Die Rolle:**
Du spielst überspitzt eine verliebte österreichische Urlauberin, die ihren jüngeren nordafrikanischen Urlaubspartner am Flughafen abholt. Der Clip ist eine klar erkennbare und humorvolle Parodie auf bekannte TV-Datingformate (Amore unter Palmen etc.).

**Drehdetails:**
📅 Freitag, 25. September
🕗 Start gegen 8/9 Uhr
⏱ Ca. 3–4 Stunden
📍 Wien und eine kurze Szene beim Flughafen
💶 Bezahlter Dreh – Vergütung inkludiert
🎥 Veröffentlichung als Social-Media-Werbevideo (mit Rechten zur Nutzung und Bewerbung)

Schauspielerfahrung ist nicht erforderlich! Wichtig sind Humor, Natürlichkeit, Lockerheit vor der Kamera und die Bereitschaft, die verliebte Rolle etwas überspitzt zu spielen.

Bei Interesse bitte möglichst rasch eine kurze Nachricht mit Foto, Telefonnummer und, falls vorhanden, einem kurzen Video oder Social-Media-Profil schicken. 😊

Schauspielersuche:
Für den Kurzfilm "AT : Es stand Alles im Wahlprogramm"
sind folgende Rollen zu besetzen 

- Arabisch /Türkischer Mann ca. 20 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkischer Mann ca 50 - 60 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca. 27 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkische Frau ca. 27 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca 45 Jahre alt
- Deutsche Frau, blond, ca 45 Jahre alt

Filminhalt :
Ein rechtradikaler Politiker sonnt sich nach einer Wahl  in seinem Erfolg.
Aber die Fassade bröckelt. Eine bittere  Politsatire. 

Aufgrund des aktuellen Bezuges sollte der Dreh schnell erfolgen, daher kann jeder Schauspieler seine Rolle am Laptop oder Smartphone selber Filmen. 
Der Film soll dann kostenfrei auf you Tube gestellt werden und jeder kann den Film sofort nutzen. Es geht darum den Film zu verbreiten, daher auch leider keine Bezahlung,  da kein Geld verdient werden kann. 
Ich hoffe es finden sich Schauspieler, die sich gegen den Rechtsradikalismus stellen und Charakter zeigen.

Ich bin Thomas Goersch,  Schauspieler und Filmregisseur www.imdb.com/name/nm1591928
Meldet Euch unter Thomas.Goersch@vodafonemail.de 
Bis dann
Thomas Goersch

A cute and heartwarming 3D animated story set on a beautiful tropical beach. 🐥💗🐍 When a fluffy pink chick calls out “Mama,” a green snake bravely protects the little chick from a hawk. A sweet story about unexpected friendship, courage, and protection. 🌴✨

Watch until the end and share this adorable moment with someone who loves cute animal stories!

sharedPost.text:
MEISNER FOUNDATION INTENSIVE - Where the magic begins!

23–25 OCTOBER 2026 | LONDON

Want to get out of your head and become a more truthful, spontaneous and instinctive actor?

Our Meisner Foundation Intensive is an immersive introduction to the Meisner Technique and the way we train actors at the Meisner Institute London.

Over three days, you’ll begin to explore the foundations of the work — really listening, responding truthfully, working moment to moment and putting your attention on your acting partner rather than yourself.

Perfect for actors who want to deepen their craft, those new to Meisner, or anyone considering joining our Core Actor Training.

The Foundation Intensive is also the prerequisite for entry to our Core Actor Training, unless you have relevant previous experience.

DATES & TIMES

Friday 23 October | 7pm–10pm
Saturday 24 October | 10am–3pm
Sunday 25 October | 10am–2pm

📍 The Cockpit Theatre, Central London
💷 £180

LAST FOUNDATION BEFORE OUR CORE ACTOR TRAINING BEGINS ON 5 NOVEMBER

Places are limited.

📩 hello@meisnerlondon.com

MEISNER INSTITUTE LONDON
Truthful. Instinctive. Alive.

#MeisnerTechnique #MeisnerLondon #ActorTraining #ActingClassesLondon #LondonActors MeisnerTraining ActingTrainingLondon ActorsLondon

📍 Birmingham

🕙 Expected finish by 8pm

🚗 Cast will meet in Prescot, Merseyside, and travel together

Applicants should be comfortable performing live, interacting with an audience and working as part of an ensemble.

To apply, please use:

https://alaraentertainment.co.uk/artist-sign-up/ or email info@alaraentertainment.co.uk

Please feel free to tag or share with anyone suitable.

**CASTING CALL - YOUNG FAMILIES**

Rose Waite Studio is casting real young families for a tech commercial. We’re specifically looking for real couples (30s) and single parents (30s) with children.

Filming: Mid October to 2nd November (one week)

Locations: London (on set, 1 day shoot) / In Talent’s Neighbourhood (where you’re based, 1 day shoot)

Talent can be based anywhere in the UK.

No previous experience needed to apply but talent should be comfortable with self shooting. 

Paid opportunity.

To apply, please send full names, location, selfie and family intro to: stories@rosewaite.com with the subject Young Family (UK)

items.text:
🌌 CASTING CALL 🌌
left eddy stories are casting for a preview performance of ‘Beneath The Camouflage Tree’ on 5th Nov at Forest Arts Centre in New Milton. We recently had a well-received performance at White Bear Theatre (aka ‘South London’s New Writing Powerhouse’ - The Stage), and have been shortlisted for the Vault Creative Arts Playwrighting Award(!), so we’re excited to do another regional preview before our small scale tour launches in 2027…

For this preview, we are looking for a female and/or gender-queer actor, based in Hampshire/Dorset to play opposite Francesca McBride (Single White Female, Generation Z, Boarders) as either JACK, a quiet but observant Lance Corporal, or EVELYN, a fiesty and playful young woman disguised as Private Anthony Fielding. If you are available from 26th Oct-5th Nov and interested in applying, please complete the application form in our link.tree: linktr.ee/BeneathTheCamouflageTree

We are asking applicants to complete the short form and tape ONE of two scene options for the role they feel like the best fit for - please choose the scene you feel most comfortable and confident with! 💙 

We’re so excited to see what everyone brings to the table 😊 

🌌 DEADLINE TO APPLY: 5pm, Monday 28th Sept 🌌 
•
#casting #theatreaudition #lgbtq #actor #hampshirearts

May be an image of text that says 'BENEATH THE CAMOUFLAGE TREE CASTING CALL ABOUT THE PLAY AND THIS STAGING Beneath the Camouflage Tree is a 'beautifully written one-act two- hander play, which was shortlisted for Vault Creative Arts Playwriting Award 2026. It follows fictional characters Jack and Tony, inspired by a composite of many real women soldiers', against the backdrop of an observation post in WW1, examining the complexity of relationships, identity, and grief. The piece has a Preview scheduled at Forest Arts Centre in New Milton on 5t November before embarking on a small-scale tour in 2027.'

May be an image of text that says 'BENEATH THE CAMOUFLAGE TREE CASTING CALL CHARACTER INFO: Jack (20-30s) is a Lance Corporal; more experienced than Tony, but still most comfortable on the edges, observing. No siblings, older parents. Not there to make friends, or be changed. We are particularly keen to hear from actors who identify as trans- masc/non-binary/gender masc/ gender non- conforming for this role, but are open to applications from anyone who feels they could be a good fit.'

May be an image of text that says 'BENEATH THE CAMOUFLAGE TREE CASTING CALL CHARACTER INFO: EVELYN/TONY Evelyn (early 20s) iS a young woman who disguises herself as Private Anthony Fielding to follow her 16yr old brother into the War. She is feisty, playful and brave, with a fire of defiance that can't be stopped. We are interested in hearing from actors who identify as LGBTQ+ for this role, but are open to applications from anyone who feels they could be a good fit.'

PPG MEDIA MODELING ACADEMY & AGENCY is now opening registrations for aspiring models in South Africa.

SPRING / SUMMER 2026 — CAPE TOWN

A.L.T. is casting female bikini models for an ongoing summer beach photoshoot project starting in October.

Experienced and first-time models are welcome.

PROJECT DETAILS
• Cape Town beach locations
• Shoot days scheduled according to weather & production requirements
• Typically 1–2 shoot days per week, with some weeks skipped
• Approx. 3–5 hours per shoot
• R1,440 per selected model, per shoot day
• No usage fee
• Professional swimwear shoot — no nudity

REQUIREMENTS
18+ • bikini/swimwear-ready physique • confident on camera • reliable • own swimwear + towel

TO APPLY:
DM or WhatsApp 076 180 2729 with:

1. Name and age
2. Measurements 
3. Cape Town location
4. 3–4 recent photos (clear, natural, full-body + close-up)
5. Instagram/TikTok link (not handle)
6. Modelling experience, if any

Selected talent will receive shoot dates directly based on project requirements.

A.L.T. | Astra Logistics & Talent
People. Opportunities. Beyond.

***CASTING CLOSED***

URGENT TVC CASTING — JOHANNESBURG

A.L.T. is urgently casting talent for an upcoming TVC production in Johannesburg. We are looking for three distinct talent profiles across featured and non-featured roles.

CASTING DETAILS

LOCAL ENTREPRENEUR
• 1 × Coloured Male
• Age: 60–65 years
• Day Rate: R3,600 × 1 day
• Usage: R6,750

CORPORATE MAN
• 1 × White Male
• Age: 30+ years
• Day Rate: R3,600 × 1 day
• Usage: R6,750

NON-FEATURED — WHEELCHAIR USER
• 1 × Black Male/Female
• Age: 21+
• Must be a wheelchair user
• Day Rate: R3,000 × 1 day

All rates are before deductions.

REQUIREMENTS
• Must meet the age, gender and profile requirements for the role applied for
• Wheelchair-user applicants must be wheelchair users
• Recent, clear headshots required
• Talent must be available for the production
• Urgent casting — submissions required ASAP

TO APPLY:
DM or WhatsApp 076 180 2729 with
1. Name, age, height
2. Location
3. Instagram/TikTok link (not handle)
4. 3–4 recent photos (clear, natural, full-body + close-up)
5. Modelling/acting experience, if any
6. Clearly state the role you are applying for

NOTE: Only complete applications meeting the role requirements will be considered. All rates are before deductions.

A.L.T. | Astra Logistics & Talent
